mapper.select: SELECT pending.relation_id FROM t_relation_outbox pending WHERE ( (pending.status = 0 AND pending.next_retry_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (pending.status = 1 AND pending.lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_relation_outbox previous WHERE previous.relation_id = pending.relation_id AND previous.relation_version < pending.relation_version AND previous.status <> 2 ) ORDER BY pending.next_retry_time, pending.event_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM t_following WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT event_id AS eventId,relation_id AS relationId,relation_version AS relationVersion,event_type AS eventType,payload,retry_count AS retryCount FROM t_relation_outbox WHERE relation_id=#{id} AND status<>2 ORDER BY relation_version LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_relation_outbox SET status = 1, claim_token = #{token}, lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND, #{leaseMicros}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE event_id = #{id} AND ( (status = 0 AND next_retry_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (status = 1 AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) )
UPDATE t_relation_outbox SET status = 2, sent_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND claim_token = #{token}

UPDATE t_relation_outbox SET status = 0, retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{delay}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), last_error = #{error}, claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE event_id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND claim_token = #{token}
